title: Updates on Binance Link Futures Bonus Reward
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians,  Binance will implement an update to the Futures Bonus Reward’s Tiering structure applicable to Binance Link to better align with our overall incentive framework.  Key Changes Effective  2026-04-09 , the previous bonus structure and associated requirements for each tier will be discontinued. Please refer to the revised Futures Bonus tiering in the table below:   Tier Fees Generated by New Users (USD) Standard 30% Referral Commission (USD) Binance Link Futures Bonus Reward (USD) Total Reward Earned (USD) Total Trading Volume (USD) Tier 1  150,000 45,000 10,000 55,000 150,000,000 Tier 2 270,000 81,000 25,000 106,000 270,000,000 Tier 3 400,000 120,000 50,000 170,000 400,000,000 We encourage all users to review the revised structure carefully to understand how it may impact your incentives moving forward. For more information, please visit the  Binance Link official page  or contact your dedicated account manager.  Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-04-09
